simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פִּיד (H6365) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פִּיד (pîyd) means (figuratively) misfortune First listed occurrence: Job 30 24.

definitions.full: H6365. pid מִּיד noun [masculine] ruin, disaster ; — absolute Job 12:5 ; construct 31:29 ; Prov 24:22 ; suffix מִּידוֺ Job 30:24 + 21:20 (for כִּיד ). מֵּיוֺת מִּיּוֺת, see מֶּה . מִּיחַ see פוח .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to pierce ;
